mechanism.claim: When a large completed BTC hourly move consumes unusually little quote turnover per unit displacement relative both to its own history and to six liquid alts, BTC liquidity is locally fragile rather than part of broad crypto repricing. Follow the BTC move for eight elapsed hours at the new upper-tail isolation crossing.
mechanism.side: strict sign of completed BTC hourly return
mechanism.why_distinct: CAIIC uses cross-sectional standardized absolute return per quote turnover. CAEVC used execution-count response minus path variation; HVLIR used a BTC-only impact level; ticket and Jensen candidates use trades or traded-price dispersion. CAIIC uses neither counts, path variation, tickets, taker direction, funding, OI, fitted models, prior event sets, nor controls.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: the completed BTC absolute hourly return must be in its causal top quintile and its isolated impact residual in the top decile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: new hourly cross-asset impact-isolation crossings with an eight-hour reservation are absent from Gross9

features.hour_window: 60 exact coherent one-minute rows [D-1h,D) per symbol
features.hour_return: log(last close/first open), strict nonzero for BTC
features.impact_zscore: for each symbol independently, z(log(raw_impact)) against at most 720 strictly prior valid hours, minimum 672, current excluded, positive finite prior sample standard deviation
features.impact_isolation: BTC impact z-score minus median of six alt impact z-scores
features.tail_ranks: strict-prior midranks of impact isolation and abs BTC return over at most 2160 prior valid seven-symbol hours, minimum 1440, current excluded
features.eligible_state: impact-isolation rank>=0.90 and abs BTC return rank>=0.80
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding exact opportunity below the isolation tail; missing prior cannot trigger
features.source_valid: all seven symbols have exact unique coherent minute grids and finite positive turnover; no imputation

clock.decision: exact hour after all seven completed paths are available
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no symbol, normalization, rank, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, comparator, control, or gate repair
